record_notes.DCP-LETT-1319: Two composition sections, April6 Government House and April7 Botanic Gardens, not mutually exclusive alternative dates. Hooker says theories interest but do not convert him, reports well-marked Sikkim willows/Rubi/Senecios/Gnaphalia despite equable climate and revises Himalayan drainage, snowline and glacier model. Falconer/Thomson and Humboldt views are attributed, current theory provisional. April7P8 recounts five-month parcel withholding, seven Frances letters released, reconciliation and good health; only later within this section explicitly acknowledges February letter received this morning and responds to incomplete cure and seven children, identifying1300. Do not let this April7 input condition April6 prose. Nepal permission attempt fails, Sylhet/Khassya/Manipur journey and Thomson joining prospective; later May1 departure is editorial. Footnote2 preserves an original Darwin abstract of this letter plus later marks: its April6 label dates the source letter, not Darwin taking notes that day in England.

record_notes.DCP-LETT-1300: February3 with editorial1850 year: newspaper first brought imprisonment news, then Darwin wrote Henslow and received a note from Sir William through that route. This is distinct from any direct incoming J.D.Hooker prompt. Liberation is hoped to occur before letter arrival, not known; continuing collecting and return home are conditional. Health plateau, cold baths, no Royal Society council attendance yet; later February7 attendance belongs only to editorial future. Fossil barnacles frustrate him, fourth son/seventh child born, chloroform administered before doctor arrived are historical reports. Requests Falconer news and sends regards; old1220 provides continuing background but does not establish immediate reply identity. Final Fitton shipwreck report follows January24 newspaper about June1849 event: distinguish news publication from event date and do not reconstruct newspaper wording as an incoming letter. Accepted full primary reading reused with matching hashes.
